audience: National interoperability authority · ministry CIO · development-partner lead

videos.title: Why a bus needs an owner
videos.message: An interoperability platform with no owner decays in its second year — name the owner before the first member joins, and split the body that sets the rules from the body that runs the bus.

videos.title: The three tiers of governance
videos.message: Strategic Council, Steering Committee, Technical Working Groups — political authority, programme leadership and the specialists, each with one job.

videos.title: The RACI matrix
videos.message: Write down who decides, who runs, who is consulted, once — it is what stops every onboarding turning into a turf fight.

videos.title: Member obligations
videos.message: What an agency signs up to when it joins is the difference between a federation and a free-for-all.

videos.title: The four Technical Working Groups
videos.message: Security, semantics, APIs, platform operations — the four standing groups that keep the bus coherent as it grows.

videos.title: Governance as living configuration
videos.message: Change control and a named standards-portfolio owner keep the framework current instead of frozen at launch.
